```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

```

```{r load-data}
final_df_complete <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/final_df_complete.rds") %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

compare_df <- final_df_complete %>%
  filter(
    urban_rural == "Urban",
    !is.na(perc_active),
    !is.na(krig_value),
    !is.na(access_walk_30),
    !is.na(target_pop_norm),
    !is.na(pct_0_12),
    !is.na(pct_13_21),
    krig_value > 0,
    access_walk_30 > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pop_3_18       = target_pop_norm * (pct_0_12 * 0.75 / 100) +
                     target_pop_norm * (pct_13_21 * 0.67 / 100),
    log10_krig     = log10(krig_value     + 1),
    log10_walk_30  = log10(access_walk_30 + 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(pop_3_18 > 0)

cat("Urban CSAs for comparison:", nrow(compare_df), "\n")
```

```{r scatter-plots}
p_krig <- plot_ly(compare_df,
        x = ~log10_krig, y = ~perc_active,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.3, color = "#e74c3c", size = 4),
        text = ~paste("Kriging (log10):", round(log10_krig, 2),
                      "<br>Active travel:", round(perc_active, 1), "%"),
        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Kriging school place density (log10 scale)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "% active travel"),
    title = "Kriging"
  )

p_walk <- plot_ly(compare_df,
        x = ~log10_walk_30, y = ~perc_active,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.3, color = "#2980b9", size = 4),
        text = ~paste("Walk (log10):", round(log10_walk_30, 2),
                      "<br>Active travel:", round(perc_active, 1), "%"),
        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "School places reachable by walking"),
    yaxis = list(title = "% active travel"),
    title = "r5r Walking"
  )

subplot(p_krig, p_walk,
        nrows = 1,
        shareY = TRUE,
        titleX = TRUE) %>%
  layout(
    title      = "Kriging vs Walking accessibility - Urban CSAs",
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

```{r correlation-bar}
cor_df <- data.frame(
  method = c("Kriging", "r5r Walking"),
  correlation = c(
    cor(compare_df$log10_krig,    compare_df$perc_active, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(compare_df$log10_walk_30, compare_df$perc_active, use = "complete.obs")
  )
)

ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = method, y = correlation, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(correlation, 3)), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Kriging"     = "#e74c3c",
    "r5r Walking" = "#2980b9"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation with active travel - Urban CSAs",
    x     = "",
    y     = "Pearson correlation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
